note: Feeds the daily news digest reads (scripts/fetch-news.ts). RSS or Atom only: a site without a feed is not scraped. Checked 2026-09-07. Bulgaria and Serbia have no reachable feed yet (api.bg did not answer, koridorisrbije.rs serves HTML, putevi-srbije.rs and metropolitan.bg return 404), so those countries are covered only by the Wikipedia article histories the projects cite, which the script watches without needing an entry here. A general feed is filtered to items that name a section or use infrastructure vocabulary; a trade feed is kept whole.
